            current_city = daily_cities[i]
            start_day = i + 1
    # Add the last segment
    itinerary.append({
        "day_range": f"Day {start_day}-20",
        "place": current_city
    })
    
    # Output JSON
    print(json.dumps({"itinerary": itinerary}, indent=2))
else:
